sources.role: RetroArch core source and core identity
official libretro BIOS and setup documentation

paths.naming: RetroArch libretro config syntax (key = "value"); core options are stored under the bluemsx core identity.
RetroPad bindings use input_playerN_<button>_btn/_axis in retroarch.cfg; autoconfig profiles use input_<button>_btn/input_<axis>_axis.

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/saves/ (or next to content when savefile_directory is unset)
paths.naming: blueMSX core persistent RAM is content-dependent; the frontend save directory is used and .sram is the documented core-side extension.; RetroArch normally uses <content-basename>.srm and related core/content sidecars where applicable.
evidence: source:records/retroarch.json RetroArch save paths and naming

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/states/ (or next to content when savestate_directory is unset)
paths.naming: RetroArch states use .state/.stateN; current pinned core metadata declares serialized savestates.; frontend slot 0 is <content-basename>.state and slots N are .stateN.
evidence: source:records/retroarch.json RetroArch state paths and naming

paths.naming: Required support pack paths are Databases/msxromdb.xml and Machines/Shared Roms/MSX.rom; upstream publishes no canonical digest for the pack files.
